name: Project A-ko 2
source:
Two mini-games of slot machine and cards are used to outscore opponents who have enormously more points at the start.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
玩家要透過老虎機和紙牌兩款小遊戲不斷得分，擊敗開局時分數遠高於自己的對手。
